name: Mary Jane Gaffney
bioAdditions: FamilySearch attaches two Ancestry index entries to her profile: a 1900 census entry for "Mary Mcguire" and a "Pennsylvania, Death Certificates, 1906-1970" entry under her maiden name, "Mary Gaffney" (S1). The second implies she died in Pennsylvania in 1906 or later, outliving her husband Edward (d. 4 Apr 1907) or dying close to him. The certificate would name her parents and Irish birthplace.
